title: Insights Library
meta_description: Perspectives across eight deep-tech domains — retrieval economics, agentic policy, PQC clocks, provenance compliance and more.

blocks.x: Practitioner theses from the delivery floor. Each insight takes a position, shows where it breaks in practice, and names the discipline that keeps it honest — no vendor theater, no borrowed hype.

The library is organized by tower: AI & data viewpoints, automation & operations, security, cloud & trust, and emerging compute. Every thesis connects to the services and case studies where it has been tested.
Read the thesis closest to your current argument — or bring your side of it to a briefing. Dissent welcome; evidence required on both sides.
A value assessment prices the delta in your estate before anything is signed: the section map above, measured against your baseline, in two weeks.
